display.summary: The 1.17 line is fixes only: every finding of a staging break-in test and the known bugs of the 1.16 line. The doctor tells the truth under failure: a missing task worker, missing static files or an image below the release floor are errors, and a dead database or a paused Redis no longer floods or freezes it. With Redis down, sign-in answers within seconds with a clear page instead of an error after a minute. An image older than the active release runs its own DjangoLux, and says so. New projects get a nonce-only script policy and Redis snapshots that survive a hard stop; existing projects get warning dlux.W201. Labels a superuser edits now render as text, accent colours keep readable text in every theme, and modal forms re-run their scripts after a refused submit. DLUX_UPDATE_POLICY can limit which updates the app may request. Needs Composer 1.11.0b1 or later; updates inline from any 1.16 release with one additive migration.
highlights: Fixes only: every staging break-in finding and known bug from the 1.16 line.
The doctor is truthful under failure and never hangs on a paused Redis or a dead database.
With Redis down, sign-in answers within seconds with a clear page, not an error.
An image below the active release's floor runs its own DjangoLux and reports it.
New projects: nonce-only script-src and Redis snapshots; existing projects get dlux.W201.
Superuser-edited labels render as text; accent text is readable in every theme.
DLUX_UPDATE_POLICY limits which updates the app may request.
Needs Composer 1.11.0b1 or later; updates inline from any 1.16 release.
